text: [roadmap S3.27, measured by S3.28] Which census checkpoints show a renderTileAtFiveOffsets silhouette: with kind 5 ported (log/roadmap/S3/28_notes.md), the full census (698 rows, raw and split) against the wave 8 stack moves exactly the rows listed in 28_out/census_cmp.tsv; the organic lowerEdgeCorner calls of the pinned terrain recordings all pass angle 0 (port/corpus/terrain/pin_*/calls.txt).

[roadmap S3.27, settled by S3.28] log/roadmap/S3/28_gl_rec.js records a3 for every entry (entry_a3 in meta.txt): lowerEdgeCorner's angle; renderTileAtFiveOffsets is a kind-5 entry too, so injected direct calls carry (tile, pivot, angle) in a0..a2 (entry_direct 1). Recording s328_s2b (cov_r_s2_screens on instances\s3_w8, SAME as det_b) holds 12 organic passes at angle 0 and 20 direct passes at 0, 90, 180 and -90.

[roadmap S3.27, measured by S3.28] GlRaster models GL_LIGHT0 only; with enableBlackLight1's zero colours light 1 adds nothing, so GlRaster from the port's kind-5 stream meets G2 on every recorded kind-5 pass (organic o3: 1 of 1,497 changed px off, by more than one level; o4 / o5 exact) and the host GL equals the original's back buffer in every pixel. Control 17 (light 1 ambient 0.2) is blind in GlRaster's pixels by construction and RED in the stream and the host GL. A non-zero light 1 colour (no caller sets one) would need GlRaster to model GL_LIGHT1 (gl_raster.cpp, S3.29's file this wave).

[roadmap S3.28] renderTileAtFiveOffsets reads the pivot's position only when pTile != NULL (the assert holds it), so a NULL pivot faults in the original at the pivot's x (Tile::getX 0x10005960); the port's renderer faults reading pivot + 0x2c in the backend drop, which LiveTerrain hands over before the state call, and the state side (terrain_state.cpp) faults at the same address after it. No recording passes a NULL pivot (applyTileElevation's tile_at_va can return 0 for a pivot outside the grid); the fault's order between drop and state call was not measured.
